existing_features.title: Fully configure Spain (country code "ES") in the EU country configuration so it is treated as a supported/ready country in the VAT calculator (correct standard VAT rate, reduced VAT rates list, reverse charge text, and configured=true).

Implement Spain-specific VAT category-to-rate mapping so that selecting a VAT Category in the transaction step can compute an appropriate reduced/super-reduced rate for Spain where applicable, otherwise falling back to Spain's standard rate.

Ensure the Spain configuration integrates cleanly with the existing transaction flow reduced-rate selection (vatTreatment="reduced" and selectedReducedRate), so Spain’s reduced rates are selectable and used consistently in the calculation result.

new_feature_requests.summary: Complete the Spain configuration fully (including VAT/category placement as needed)
